2. Check whether anything legitimately depends on the public access, such as a static website, a CDN origin or shared downloads. Blocking public access will break those.
3. Run it with your approved parameters:
   `aws ssm start-automation-execution --document-name AWSConfigRemediation-ConfigureS3BucketPublicAccessBlock --parameters BucketName=<bucket>,AutomationAssumeRole=<role-arn> --region us-west-2`
4. Confirm the execution status is `Success`. Then re-run `get-public-access-block` and check that all four settings are `true`. Security Hub should move the finding to resolved on its next evaluation.
